value.hook: Writing or editing a pij docs page, concepts.md, a type page or any text a seat is told
value.title: Pages a seat reads must describe only what main ships

sections.name: body
sections.value: PRD 009's goal is that the docs a seat reads match the pij it runs, and both reviews of #348/#351 turned on breaking it. Before pushing a page: (1) every construct in the present tense must exist on main (pods, pod templates, per-instance memory were described as present and were not: parked in a "Coming" section tagged with their PRD); (2) when a dependency PRD merges, grep the pages for "planned (PRD N)" and update them in the next PR (007 made three stale at once); (3) don't state one fleet's framing as universal (the factory/product framing is the build-fleet case; operating fleets build nothing); (4) where a rule is under the operator's review, say how main works today plus one line that it may change; (5) every command a page cites must exist with that grammar: check the help text in crates/core/src/directory.rs or pij-rs-api.md, not memory. The bundled-docs gate only proves a page equals its file, never that it is true.
